notice: Aegis provides control mappings and evidence management, not certification or audit. Mappings marked 'unreviewed' have not yet been checked against the official framework text. Aegis rules are Aegis-specific and are not official framework requirements.

controls.title: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained
Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization
Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties
The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected
Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested
Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage
Configuration management practices are established and applied
Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring
Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events

frameworks.name: CIS Amazon Web Services Foundations Benchmark

controls.title: Ensure no 'root' user account access key exists
Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account
Ensure IAM policies that allow full "*:*" administrative privileges are not attached
Ensure that S3 Buckets are configured with 'Block public access (bucket settings)'
Ensure that encryption-at-rest is enabled for RDS Instances
Ensure that public access is not given to RDS Instance
Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
Ensure CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
Ensure no security groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to remote server administration ports
Ensure no security groups allow ingress from ::/0 to remote server administration ports
Data stores are not publicly accessible
Data stores are encrypted at rest with an explicit configuration
Data is recoverable: versioning is enabled and stateful resources are not destroyed without approval
IAM permissions follow least privilege; no full-administrator policies
Administrative ports are not exposed to the internet
Audit logging is enabled with integrity validation
Every resource carries owner, environment and cost-center tags
Resources are deployed only in approved regions

rules.title: S3 bucket blocks all public access
rules.remediation: Add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block with all four settings set to true.

rules.title: S3 bucket has explicit server-side encryption
Database storage is encrypted at rest
rules.remediation: Set storage_encrypted = true (requires a new instance for existing databases).

rules.title: Database is not publicly accessible
rules.remediation: Set publicly_accessible = false and reach the database through private networking.

rules.title: No IAM policy grants all actions on all resources
rules.remediation: Replace Action "*" / Resource "*" with the specific actions and resources required.

rules.title: No administrative ports open to the IPv4 internet (0.0.0.0/0)
rules.remediation: Restrict ports 22/3389 to known CIDR ranges or use a bastion/SSM Session Manager.

rules.title: No administrative ports open to the IPv6 internet (::/0)
rules.remediation: Restrict ports 22/3389 to known IPv6 ranges or use a bastion/SSM Session Manager.

rules.title: CloudTrail logging and log file validation are enabled
rules.remediation: Set enable_logging = true and enable_log_file_validation = true.

rules.title: Required ownership and cost tags are present
rules.remediation: Add owner, environment and cost_center tags (provider default_tags recommended).

rules.title: Resource is in an approved region
rules.remediation: Deploy to an approved region or request a documented exception.

rules.title: Stateful resources are not deleted or replaced without approval
rules.remediation: Avoid force-replacement (e.g. lifecycle prevent_destroy) or obtain an approved change exception.
